question: Who understood time in this way as a mode of cognition?
premises: The preceding verses established time as a mode of cognition.
This understanding was received within a specific teaching lineage.
The lineage is identified by devotion to the guru called Bhavatī.
inference: The doctrine that time is a mode of cognition was understood by those who served the revered guru known as Bhavatī.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the guru called Bhavatī is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: In this way, the status of time as cognition was understood here by certain teachers who attended upon the revered guru feet known as Bhavatī.
